items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: What molecular explanation accounts for the solution absorption of source organoboron dyes1 and2 and their response to the two supplied solvents? Determine whether proposed structural/electronic differences are supported beyond a coincidental match to an absorption maximum.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. Restrict claims to the two molecular dyes and solution absorption. A molecular rotation, excitation or static barrier cannot establish photobleaching yield, hydrolytic lifetime, cell-staining mechanism or biocompatibility. Methanol/chloroform comparisons do not isolate viscosity as the only changed property.
